verdict.rationale: Sierra is a SaaS platform for building agents, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documentation of an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. The Agent SDK material describes writing journeys as code and inspecting API calls, but never mentions a downloadable spec.
